note: Amharic (am) is new to the library and not yet in language_seed.py (added from the admin). Scripture authority is the 1962 Amharic Bible (United Bible Societies; NT revised 2003) — the text Amharic churches of every tradition quote. Its New Testament was fetched whole from the ebible mirror (gracious-tech/fetch_collection, bibles/amh_amh, USFM; ebible id `amh`). The mirror carries the NT only, so every Old Testament quotation is necessarily self_rendered in the 1962 register.

Licence: the mirror records the 1962/2003 text as © UBS, attribution required, non-commercial, no derivatives. Verbatim quotation in this free library is neither commercial nor a derivative, but the credit line is owed wherever these verses render — see the PR; a founder decision before Amharic goes live.

A `mined` row means an exact byte substring of the 1962 NT of at least 20 characters, measured against the finished text — not a translator's claim; its source_file names the edition, not a corpus file (no Amharic corpus exists yet). Shorter or adapted quotations are self_rendered.
